mechanism_narrative: The sharp one-week rebound in WORKPLACES after t-2w signals a partial return of weekday commuting, which should raise retail visits with about a 2-4 week lag as lunch and after-work shopping recover.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by at least 10 points from its recent trough
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve relative to the prior 4 weeks by week t+4 after WORKPLACES rises at least 10 points from a recent trough.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent elevation in RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates more people staying home, which suppresses discretionary retail trips in the following 1-2 weeks as activity shifts toward at-home routines.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not lower within 14 days when RESIDENTIAL remains above its recent average or rises further.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT drops further while WORKPLACES stay weak, stricter movement control or voluntary avoidance is curbing shopping trips; retail mobility should fall over the next 4 weeks because access costs remain high.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -27 while WORKPLACES stays below -20 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite TRANSIT staying below -27 and WORKPLACES staying below -20 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS mobility during a holiday or pleasant-weather window diverts discretionary outings away from malls and shopping streets, reducing retail-and-recreation visits within 1 week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases by more than 8 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to decline in the week after PARKS jumps by more than 8 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stays elevated while WORKPLACES remain depressed, households complete essential trips but avoid discretionary retail, so RETAIL_REC stays below the prior month over the next 2 weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not underperform the previous 4-week mean within 14 days even though GROCERY_PHARM stays elevated and WORKPLACES stay depressed.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in TRANSIT above its recent range should precede stronger retail traffic because easier cross-district access restores shopping trips and dine-out errands within 4 weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 5 points from the prior week after being below -25
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve over the next 28 days after TRANSIT rises at least 5 points from the prior week.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL stays above 10 while PARKS remain deeply negative, people are concentrating time at home rather than in outside leisure, which should keep retail-and-recreation mobility weak for the next 4 weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL staying above 10 and PARKS staying negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained improvement in PARKS combined with stable or rising TRANSIT indicates broader weekend and leisure circulation, which should spill over into retail visits after about 2 weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises for two consecutive weeks while TRANSIT does not fall further
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days after PARKS rises for two consecutive weeks and TRANSIT remains stable or higher.
